description: This 2025 Chevrolet Silverado 3500HD LT in gray delivers the capability and comfort you need for work or weekend adventures. Engineered with the Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine producing 470 horsepower and 975 lb-ft of torque, paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, this truck handles demanding tasks with confidence.  - Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel Engine with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft torque - 10-Speed Automatic Transmission with 4WD - Trail Boss Package with 20" high-gloss black wheels and BF Goodrich off-road tires - Z71 Off-Road Package with Rancho shocks and Hill Descent Control - Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package for towing flexibility - Front bucket seats with center console and leather package - Dual-zone automatic climate control with heated seats and steering wheel - Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto - HD Surround Vision and bed view camera with trailer camera provisions - Hitch Guidance with Hitch View and Trailering App - Remote start package with theft-deterrent system - 120-volt bed-mounted power outlet and power sliding rear window - LED fog lamps and animated LED projector headlamps - Chevytec spray-on black bedliner - Front and rear park assist with trailer side blind zone alert  The interior combines functionality with modern convenience. Your front bucket seats feature a center console with lockable storage, while the leather trim adds refinement. Dual-zone climate control keeps you and your passengers comfortable, and the heated steering wheel provides extra warmth during cold seasons. The 10-way power driver seat with lumbar support ensures you stay comfortable through long drives.  Technology keeps you connected and in control. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system offers seamless smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while SiriusXM with 360L provides your favorite entertainment. The bed view camera with trailer camera provisions, combined with HD Surround Vision and hitch guidance, makes maneuvering and hitching straightforward and safe.  The Trail Boss and Z71 Off-Road packages transform this truck into a serious off-road machine. Black grille inserts, high-gloss black bumpers, red tow hooks, and a black skid plate create aggressive styling, while the Rancho shocks and Hill Descent Control enhance your off-road performance. The BF Goodrich LT275/65R20 tires are built for challenging terrain.  Safety features give you peace of mind on every journey. Front and rear park assist, trailer side blind zone alert, rear cross traffic alert, and HD Surround Vision help you navigate tight spaces and stay aware of your surroundings. The engine block heater ensures reliable cold-weather starts, while the 220-amp alternator and heavy-duty battery provide dependable power for all your equipment.  This Silverado 3500HD LT represents serious truck capability backed by proven engineering. description: You're looking at a substantial 2014 Dodge Durango Limited that brings serious capability to the road with its HEMI 5.7L V8 engine and all-wheel drive system.  - HEMI 5.7L V8 with Multi Displacement and Variable Valve Timing - Trailer Tow Group IV with Class IV Receiver Hitch - Rear Load Leveling Suspension for enhanced stability - Heavy-Duty Engine Cooling system - 7 & 4 Pin Wiring Harness for towing - Full Size Spare Tire and Steel Spare Wheel - Three rows of seating with split-folding rear seats - Heated leather-trimmed bucket seats and heated rear seats - Uconnect 8.4A with SiriusXM satellite radio and Bluetooth connectivity - Rear parking camera and rear parking sensors - Rear air conditioning with dual front zone climate control - 18-inch polished aluminum wheels - Dual front and side impact airbags with overhead airbags - Electronic Stability Control and traction control  The Durango Limited delivers the space your family needs with its three-row configuration and ample cargo versatility. The heated leather seating, automatic climate control zones, and Uconnect infotainment system create a comfortable environment for every journey. This model prioritizes safety with its comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, and rear parking sensors to assist you confidently. The HEMI V8 delivers the power expected from this platform while the all-wheel drive system handles varied driving conditions throughout the year.  The Durango Limited combines practical three-row family transportation with the capability to handle towing and cargo duties. Standard conveniences include power seats and windows, heated mirrors, remote keyless entry, and a telescoping steering wheel.
